habitat: Hill and submontane mixed dipterocarp forests at 600–1220 m
story: In the diverse world of birds, the Hose Broadbill (Calyptomena hosii) stands out. This species, part of the Calyptomenidae family, is a resident of Hill and submontane mixed dipterocarp forests at 600–1220 m. Its IUCN Red List status is Least Concern (LC), which serves as a call to action for habitat preservation. The Hose Broadbill is more than just a bird; it is a symbol of the rich biodiversity that we must protect. Through this poster, we hope to foster a greater understanding and appreciation for the Hose Broadbill and its role in the ecosystem.
Every poster is crafted to inspire curiosity about our planet's incredible biodiversity.
